description: This PHP class defines the jirasoapInterface, which integrates TestLink with Jira via SOAP. It handles connecting to Jira, retrieving issues, creating issues, and processing configuration attributes specific to Jira's SOAP API.

classes.name: jirasoapInterface
classes.description: A class for integrating TestLink with Jira using SOAP, enabling issue retrieval, creation, and configuration management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, sets configurations, and establishes connection to Jira SOAP API.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes the configuration with default URLs, attributes, and issue defaults.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves a Jira issue by ID via SOAP and enriches it with TestLink-specific properties.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if the bug ID matches the expected syntax.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a SOAP connection to Jira and authenticates.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to Jira is established.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a SOAP client object for Jira.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template configuration XML for Jira SOAP integration.

methods.name: getStatusDomain
methods.description: Returns the mapping of Jira status names to IDs.

methods.name: checkEnv
methods.description: Checks if SOAP extension is loaded in PHP.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new Jira issue via SOAP with given summary and description.

methods.name: setResolvedStatusCfg
methods.description: Configures which Jira statuses are considered resolved or closed.

methods.name: addIssueFromArray
methods.description: Creates a Jira issue from a provided array of issue data.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Checks if API-based issue creation is configured.

methods.name: processAttributes
methods.description: Processes and sets custom attributes for Jira issues.

methods.name: getRelaxedAttribute
methods.description: Processes simplified attribute data and stores it.

methods.name: getCustomFieldsAttribute
methods.description: Processes custom field attributes for Jira issues.
